title: Introducing AniyaAI: An Offline 3D AI Companion with TTS Voice and Real-Time Transcription for Enhanced Voice Chat Interactions - Try early alpha Aniya for free!
author: Cheese_Us

comments.author: Cheese_Us
comments.body:
Hi everyone,

I'm excited to introduce you to my newest project, AniyaAI. It's an offline 3D AI companion designed for voice-based interactions, complete with TTS voice capabilities and real-time transcription to enhance chat experiences. You can check it out here: [https://elushis.itch.io/aniyaai](https://elushis.itch.io/aniyaai).

AniyaAI is inspired by my earlier work on PastPortal: Chat Suite, where users can engage in dialogues with iconic figures from history and fiction. You can explore PastPortal here: [https://elushis.itch.io/pastportal](https://elushis.itch.io/pastportal).

I'm currently releasing the early alpha version of AniyaAI, and I'd be thrilled if you'd give it a try. Feedback is always appreciated as it helps shape the future of the program.

Thanks for taking the time to check it out!

comments.author: Tyrannicus100BC
comments.body: Looks pretty awesome! What’s your tech stack? Clearly Whisper for STT [blank_audio] is a dead ringer. Guessing llama.cop with llama2 model? Which size? Also what TTS are you using?

replies.author: Cheese_Us
replies.body: Thank you! Indeed, I'm using the Whisper system for STT. For processing,  I utilize the Llama.cpp library which has been compiled with uGPT, and I'm using it with a 7b Llama 2 Uncensored Model.  As for TTS, I found this fantastic asset called Overtone. Probably my favorite TTS solution thus far due to the fact its completely offline + variety of voices. I've tried some other TTS options for a few other projects but this one has been my favorite.

comments.author: wzol
comments.body: Is it possible to train it?

replies.author: Cheese_Us
replies.body: Absolutely! You can integrate a custom-trained model with AniyaAI. I've experimented with several models (some my own) using quantization methods like q4\_1 and q5\_1 within the ggml framework. Inserting custom model won't work in the current build but I can easily do so in an update if that's something people would like to experiment with.

replies.author: wzol
replies.body: Ok, that is not my level :) For easy solution, can someone upload a PDF for it?
